detail: Both corpus texts ingested from .txt with `lc ingest` and indexed with `lc anchor`; every paragraph located with locate.Locations.of_workspace (doc-control `locate` and `page.estimate` on the snapshot (the .txt itself), one call each). A head … tail counts as met by each paragraph of the document (doc-control's paragraph text, cleaned, case ignored) that starts with the head's words and ends with the tail's; a Find string by each place the joined document text holds it (paragraph marks included, any case, overlaps counted). Every returned phrase and Find string is met exactly once. Phrases show doc-control's head/tail widened to at least four words a side (more words never make a unique pair ambiguous). Not returned: 11 Marianela paragraphs that repeat another word for word (doc-control reason `duplicate`) point to the paragraph before them (`after`); none lacks a Find phrase: doc-control 0.5.0 gives the 11 duplicates, and the 17 short lines with no unique run of their own, a phrase across a paragraph mark (`find_phrase_across`; with 0.4.1, 11 Marianela duplicates had none); Find strings are doc-control's `find_phrase_word` (Find-box ^ codes, ^p for the mark). A quote passed to `lc docx locate` is typed as doc-control's `find` gives it (`query_word`, Find-box ^ codes) when Word meets it once.
timing: worst of three in-process runs, workspace already ingested and anchored. Locators for every 25th paragraph (load + locate): jekyll-hyde 0.04 s before, 0.23 s after; marianela 0.20 s before, 1.09 s after. Every paragraph: jekyll-hyde 0.33 s before, 0.42 s after; marianela 3.75 s before, 3.87 s after (both dominated by query.paragraph_range's linear scan per anchor). `lc docx locate <anchor>` on the corpus converted to .docx: jekyll-hyde 0.09 s before, 0.33 s after; marianela 0.34 s before, 1.07 s after. The fixed cost is doc-control's whole-document `locate` (its Find-phrase index, about 0.5 s of 0.54 s on Marianela, more under the .txt conversion and a second parse), paid once per process.
removed: locate.LocatorBuilder (own unique-run search, 300 words per page model), docx_cli.Finder and find_string (own Word Find search); load_meta no longer drops pages
timing_cold_docx_locate: cold `lc docx locate --document novel.docx <anchor>` (one fresh process each, 3 anchors, workspace from tests' _novel_docx(100_000) ingested and anchored): doc-control 0.4.1 0.83-1.03 s; 0.5.0 without `structure: false` 0.85-0.95 s; 0.5.0 with it 0.68-0.82 s. What remains is doc-control's one parse of the .docx (build_index, about 0.65 s).
